claims: WrestleMania 42 streams live in the U.S. on ESPN+ via the ESPN App/Unlimited plan.
The full two-day event of WrestleMania 42 is available on ESPN+.
The first hour of each night of WrestleMania 42 airs on linear TV.
The first hour of Saturday night of WrestleMania 42 airs on ESPN2.
The first hour of Sunday night of WrestleMania 42 airs on ESPN.
Netflix hosts WWE Premium Live Events in most regions internationally.
The WrestleMania kickoff show streams on YouTube.
The WrestleMania kickoff show streams on ESPN Unlimited.
As of April 2026, the WWE Network/Premium Live Events have moved to ESPN+ in the U.S.
As of April 2026, the WWE Network/Premium Live Events have moved to Netflix internationally.
